svg.title: Подъём штанги перед собой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing BARBELL FRONT RAISE in three-quarter SIDE view to clearly see forward motion. Both hands grasp ONE straight barbell shoulder-width, palms down. Left: straightish arms hang, barbell in front of upper thighs. Right: same arms raised FORWARD to shoulder height, elbows slightly bent, barbell in front of face at shoulder height, not overhead, not upright row. Barbell must have ONE long connected shaft and weight plates at both ends. Torso upright, feet on floor. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
